The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with multiple AssertionError messages indicating cells H46 through L47 contained '#NAME?' instead of the expected numerical values. This error typically occurs when a formula uses an undefined name or an unrecognized function. While the file structure and lookup blocks passed, the statistical calculations in the 'Task' worksheet are broken. Avoid using non-standard Excel functions or uninitialized named ranges in openpyxl.
